items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a drummer named Jimmy King... I had a drummer with me named Jimmy King was our first vocalist... this was the beginning of my first band, the Wilberforce Collegians

ctx.x: Huh. Let's see, Also they weren't able to list the drummer here. They have Luke Look Stewart, guitar, Sylvester Turpin on bass, and do you recall who the drummer was at that time?
I had a drummer named Jimmy King. He's deceased now. And when you said Look Stewart, the Luke banjo player -- played banjo.
I see. Okay, good. He did not play guitar? He was playing banjo?
